subject.title: improve: index transcript mirror persistence checks

question: Should OpenClaw make supplied-key existence, persisted user-message recovery, and exact message-event count stable generic Plugin SDK write-lock APIs for extension mirrors?
rationale: The implementation needs these facts at the plugin boundary, but the public contract, long-term ownership, and compatibility promise cannot be inferred from a contributor PR alone.

options.title: Approve the narrow SDK facts
options.body: Treat the three readers as stable generic transcript-write facts, then require a current-main rebase and refreshed current-head proof before merge.

options.title: Keep facts owner-specific
options.body: Decline the public SDK expansion and redesign the optimization behind an existing owner-specific or generic internal seam.

options.title: Defer the contract
options.body: Pause this child until transcript and Plugin SDK owners define the intended public API boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow SDK facts
recommendation.body: Treat the three readers as stable generic transcript-write facts, then require a current-main rebase and refreshed current-head proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged transcript foundation and authored the proposed follow-on SDK seam, so they are the best available technical routing contact in the available history.
